# sportsdata

> A free, open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives any AI client live
> sports data and cross-book betting odds. Over 60 providers and 750 tools. MIT licensed,
> no account and no API key required. Runs on the user's own machine.

sportsdata exposes two things: a **data plane** (the MCP server, usable from Claude Desktop,
Cursor or any MCP client) and an optional **agent workbench app** (a local desktop app where
a team of specialist agents answers questions with visible tool traces). Both are free.

Coverage: AFL, NRL, NBA, MLB, NFL, NHL, EPL, cricket, golf, tennis, F1, UFC, and horse,
harness and greyhound racing. Odds from 11 bookmakers (Sportsbet, TAB, Pinnacle, Unibet,
PointsBet, Ladbrokes, Neds, betr, Dabble, FanDuel) plus the Kalshi and Polymarket
prediction markets, and official league feeds (AFL, NRL, NBA Stats, MLB StatsAPI, ESPN,
DataGolf, OpenF1, Cricket Australia).

Install: `uvx sportsdata-mcp serve`

Important: sportsdata returns data for information only. It is not betting or financial
advice, and it is for adults 18 and over. Some bookmaker feeds are geo-restricted outside
their home region.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sportsdata-ai.com/): What the MCP server is, what it covers, and how to install it.
- [Browse every tool](https://sportsdata-ai.com/#feeds): The full tool catalogue by provider, with parameters and sample responses.
- [Get it](https://sportsdata-ai.com/#get): Install instructions for the MCP data plane and the agent app.
- [FAQ](https://sportsdata-ai.com/#faq): What MCP is, cost, coverage, installation, privacy.
- [Agent types](https://sportsdata-ai.com/agents.html): The 28-agent roster grouped into six kinds (router, data specialists, quant, guardrails, domain, meta), the anatomy of an agent spec, and the FPL Manager agent as a full worked example.
- [Racing board](https://sportsdata-ai.com/board/): Live racing money-flow terminal — firmers, fair price, value across Sportsbet, PointsBet and Betfair.
- [Sports board](https://sportsdata-ai.com/sports/): Team-sports terminal using prediction markets and the exchange as the sharp line.
- [Search](https://sportsdata-ai.com/search.html): Search the site and the full tool catalogue.
- [Sitemap](https://sportsdata-ai.com/sitemap.html): Every page in one list.

## Machine-readable

- [Tool catalogue (JSON)](https://sportsdata-ai.com/catalogue.json): Every provider and tool, with descriptions, arguments and sample responses.
- [XML sitemap](https://sportsdata-ai.com/sitemap.xml)

## Source

- [sportsdata-mcp](https://github.com/DanielTomaro13/sportsdata-mcp): The MCP data plane.
- [sportsdata-agents](https://github.com/DanielTomaro13/sportsdata-agents): The agent workbench app.

## Support

sportsdata is built and maintained by one person and is free for everyone. Donations are
voluntary, unlock nothing, and gate nothing.

- [Support on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/danieltomaro)
